items.title: test(ui): scope storage recovery checks to the fixture
items.summary: test(ui): scope storage recovery checks to the fixture The storage-failure test mounts a recovery component while the app stays alive. Disabling IndexedDB can make the app render its own recovery notice between the fixture click and text read, making the page-wide locator ambiguous. Give the fixture an ID and bind its notice lookup to that owner. Keep strict summary selection and every existing assertion. A held storage module reproduces the two-owner ambiguity before this change and passes afterwards with one summary in each component.
